purpose: Published descriptions of the Delhi Police structure (districts, sub-divisions, stations) in each year before the 2017 gazette schedule. Supports, but does not prove, reuse of the 2014 station roster for 2011-2013 and 2015. Not a station roster.
caveat: Station totals count different things in different reports (territorial plus special, railway, metro, airport and other units), so the totals are not comparable year to year. Only the 2014-15 report and the Dec 2014 Lok Sabha answer split out 161 territorial stations.
retrieval: Internet Archive captures of the MHA URLs, fetched 2026-10-19. The PDFs are not committed (6-17 MB each); the SHA-256 identifies the exact capture read.

reports.note: The roster used for the 2014 reference map.

readAs: The 11-district, 54-sub-division structure is stated in every MHA annual report from 2010-11 to 2014-15, so no district or sub-division was added or removed in that period.

Territorial stations were 161 in 2014-15 and 163 in the Nov 2017 schedule; the two extra (North Avenue, South Avenue) appeared after the 2014 archive. The 2015-16 report counts 190 stations of all kinds, up from 181, with no territorial split.
Rohini and Shahdara were notified 14 Oct 2016 and reported as newly created in early Dec 2016 (press); Dwarka followed on 9 Nov 2017.
None of this lists station-by-station membership before 2014, so a single station moving between districts cannot be ruled out.
